biotools.summary: Pf-HaploAtlas is a web application enabling exploratory data analysis of genomic variation in Plasmodium falciparum, facilitating spatial and temporal exploration of genes and variants of interest. The application is freely available and its source code is accessible on GitHub under the MIT license.
